successCriteria.description: For every input, the Notification produced/persisted by NotificationService.notify has relatedEntityType and relatedEntityId either both null or both non-null — never exactly one set.
An input where exactly one of relatedEntityType/relatedEntityId is provided is rejected with a ValidationError (code VALIDATION_ERROR, HTTP 400) before any repository.create call is made.

Both-absent and both-present inputs continue to behave as before: both-absent coerces to null/null, both-present preserves the provided values, and the resulting Notification is persisted via repository.create.
A unit test exists covering the exactly-one-field-provided case (both directions: type-only and id-only), asserting rejection; existing both-absent and both-present tests still pass.

constraints: The invariant is enforced in NotificationService.notify at the service boundary, not in PgNotificationRepository.create — the repository persists whatever it is given.
Rejection must use the existing ValidationError from src/shared/types/errors.ts (code VALIDATION_ERROR, HTTP 400) — no new error type.
The Notification entity field types remain string | null for both relatedEntityType and relatedEntityId; the NotificationInput optional-plus-nullable shape is unchanged.
outOfScope: No change to PgNotificationRepository.create or any repository-level enforcement — the repository remains a pass-through persister.
No change to the Notification/NotificationInput model field types or nullability semantics.
No new error type, no HTTP route/controller changes, and no database schema/migration changes.

entityInvariants.invariant: relatedEntityType and relatedEntityId are always both null or both non-null — a Notification never carries a partially-set related-entity pair.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Rejects input where exactly one of relatedEntityType/relatedEntityId is provided by throwing ValidationError (VALIDATION_ERROR, 400) before persisting; otherwise persists and returns the Notification.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Reuse the existing ValidationError class (code VALIDATION_ERROR, statusCode 400) rather than introducing a new error type.
Match the existing Notification entity field types (relatedEntityType/relatedEntityId: string | null) and NotificationInput optional-plus-nullable shape; do not change the model.
Preserve the existing notify behavior for valid inputs (id generation, createdAt at write time, status PENDING, readAt null, client passthrough to repository.create).
